note: Tahoe National Forest campground on a pine-covered bench above the west shore of Prosser Creek Reservoir, 10 minutes north of Truckee; the shore is a walk away and a boat ramp is about half a mile off. Water supply has been limited or out of service, so arrive with water. OHVs must be trailered to the trails west of Highway 89. --Claude
summary: FS page, rec.gov record + catalog + 28 site photos, imagery and a 3DEP profile read. $20, $5 extra vehicle; 29 back-in sites (28 fit 23 ft, one 20 ft), max 60; no hookups, vault toilets; water unreliable. Seasonal May 22 - Sep 26 (2026); closed for the season now. Waterfront: lakeview NOT confirmed -> not waterfront (downgrade). Phone and website to fill.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakeview -> not waterfront (the stored value is not --AWH). No recreation.gov site photo (28 of 29 viewed; 022 would not load) shows the reservoir; every site sits in a continuous Jeffrey pine stand. The nearest site to full pool is 024 (39.37697,-120.16095): ~1750 m full-pool edge ~140 m south and ~25 m below it, through forest (3DEP: 1775.7 site, 1758.2 at the forest edge 110 m out, 1746.5 at 152 m). For keeping lakeview, the reviewer has the FS page's 'Some sites have filtered views of the reservoir ... through the trees' (agency prose, not a sole basis) and site 008's photo (39.37828,-120.16124), which looks east through trees across an open sage flat toward the basin. That basin was drawn down in the November 2018 photo, so no water shows; full-pool water lies ~400 m+ off across the flat and the boat-ramp road.
